meta.title: Create Proposal opens the Note for Approval screen

plan.title: Create Proposal opens Note for Approval

steps.note: Open the prepared event with bids in Master QCS.
Enter the awarding screen required before creating a proposal.
Complete the award allocation so Create Proposal becomes available.
Verify that all line items and the vendor are allocated before proposal creation.
Create the award proposal from the completed awarding screen.
Verify that the proposal review screen opened.
Verify that the Note for Approval control is present on the proposal screen.
Verify the event overview section is available for review.
Verify the allocation summary section is available.
Verify the comparison sheets section is available.
Verify the participants and allocations section is available.
